```{r}
fire <- read.csv("train.csv")
fire <- fire %>%
  mutate(fire_month_period = case_when(
      event_start_month >= 1 & event_start_month <= 5 ~ "Non-summer (1-5)",
      event_start_month >= 6 & event_start_month <= 9 ~ "Summer (6-9)")
  )
fire$area_growth_rate_ha_per_h[fire$event_id == "77028404"] <- 0
fire$radial_growth_rate_m_per_h[fire$event_id == "77028404"] <- 0
fire$log_area_ratio_0_5h[fire$event_id == "77028404"] <- 0
# 77028404 has tiny small non-negative values, transformed to 0
  
fire_sum <- fire %>% rename(
  "Low temporal resolution" = low_temporal_resolution_0_5h,
  "Area growth rate (ha/hr)" = area_growth_rate_ha_per_h,
  "Initial area (log)" = log1p_area_first,
  "Ratio of final to initial area (log)" = log_area_ratio_0_5h,
  "Rate of radial growth (m/hr)" = radial_growth_rate_m_per_h,
  "Centroid Movement Speed" = centroid_speed_m_per_h,
  "Angle between fire move and evac (cos)" = alignment_cos,
  "Angle between fire move and evac (abs)" = alignment_abs,
  "Fire start hour" = event_start_hour,
  "Fire start day of week" = event_start_dayofweek,
  "Fire start month" = fire_month_period
)
fire_sum$`Low temporal resolution` = factor(fire_sum$`Low temporal resolution`, 
                                            levels = c(0, 1), labels = c("No", "Yes"))
fire_sum$event = factor(fire_sum$event, levels = c(0, 1), labels = c("Fire Not Hit", "Fire Hit"))


my.render.cont <- function(x) {
  s <- stats.default(x)
  c(
    " " = "",  
    "Mean (SD)" = sprintf("%.2f (%.2f)", s$MEAN, s$SD),
    "Median [Min, Max]" = sprintf("%.2f [%.2f, %.2f]", s$MEDIAN, s$MIN, s$MAX)
  )
}

# Table 1 (full predictors)
tab1 <- table1(~ `Low temporal resolution` + `Area growth rate (ha/hr)` + `Initial area (log)` +
                `Ratio of final to initial area (log)` + `Rate of radial growth (m/hr)` + 
                 `Centroid Movement Speed` +  `Angle between fire move and evac (cos)` + 
                 `Fire start hour` + `Fire start day of week`  + `Fire start month` | event, 
               data = fire_sum, 
       render.continuous=my.render.cont,
       caption = "Summary statistics of the features by fire hit status.")
```

```{r}
# Kaplan-Meier
surv_obj <- Surv(time = fire$time_to_hit_hours, event = fire$event)
surv.fit <- survfit(surv_obj~1, conf.int = 0.95)
survfit2(surv_obj ~ 1, data = fire) |>
  ggsurvfit() +
  add_confidence_interval() +
  add_risktable() +                   
  add_risktable_strata_symbol() +
  scale_ggsurvfit() +
  labs(
    title = "Kaplan-Meier Survival Curve",
    x = "Time from fire started + 5 hrs (hours)",
    y = "Survival Probability"
  ) +
  theme_classic()

# KM by fire season
surv.fit.by.season <- survfit(surv_obj ~ fire_month_period, data = fire, conf.type = "log-log")
ggsurvplot(
  surv.fit.by.season,
  data = fire,
  conf.int = TRUE,
  conf.int.alpha = 0.15,
  palette = c("#E41A1C", "#377EB8"),  
  title = "Kaplan-Meier Survival Curve by Season",
  xlab = "Time from fire started + 5 hrs (hours)",
  ylab = "Survival Probability",
  legend.title = "Season",
  

  legend.labs = c("Non-summer", "Summer"),
  risk.table = TRUE,
  risk.table.title = "Number at Risk",
  risk.table.height = 0.30,  
  risk.table.y.text = TRUE,   
  risk.table.fontsize = 3.5,
  tables.theme = theme_cleantable(),
  

  ggtheme = theme_classic(),
  pval = TRUE,                
  pval.coord = c(0.1, 0.1)    
)

# KM by low resolution
surv.fit.resol <- survfit(surv_obj ~ low_temporal_resolution_0_5h, data = fire, conf.type = "log-log")

  surv.fit.resol,
  data = fire,
```

```{r}
###################################
# Prepocessing
###################################
fire <- fire %>%
  mutate(
    hour_sin = sin(2 * pi * event_start_hour / 24),
    hour_cos = cos(2 * pi * event_start_hour / 24),
    dow_sin  = sin(2 * pi * event_start_dayofweek / 7),
    dow_cos  = cos(2 * pi * event_start_dayofweek / 7)
  )

############################################################################
# Log transformation for right-skewed variables
# 
# Variables with negatives are left on original scale.
############################################################################

fire <- fire %>%
  mutate(
    log_area_growth_rate  = log1p(area_growth_rate_ha_per_h),
    log_radial_growth     = log1p(radial_growth_rate_m_per_h),
    log_centroid_speed    = log1p(centroid_speed_m_per_h),
    )

numericlog_vars <-  c("log_area_growth_rate", "log_radial_growth", "log_centroid_speed")

# Violin and box plots (log-transformed)
fire_long_log <- fire %>%
  dplyr::select(event, all_of(numericlog_vars)) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = -event,
               names_to = "Variable",
               values_to = "Value")
ggplot(fire_long_log,
       aes(x = factor(event), y = Value, fill = factor(event))) +
  geom_violin(trim = FALSE) +
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.12, outlier.alpha = 0.2) +
  facet_wrap(~ Variable,
             ncol = 4, nrow = 3,
             scales = "free_y") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    strip.text = element_text(size = 9)
  ) +
  labs(x = "Event",
       y = "Value",
       title = "Fire Features by Event Status")
```

```{r}
##############################################################
# Variable Selection Elastic Net (alpha = 0.5) with 5-fold CV
##############################################################
fire <- fire %>%
  mutate(is_summer = as.integer(fire_month_period == "Summer (6-9)"))

feature_vars <- c(
  "log1p_area_first",
  "log_area_growth_rate",
  "log_area_ratio_0_5h",    
  "log_radial_growth",
  "log_centroid_speed",
  
  "alignment_cos",

  "low_temporal_resolution_0_5h",

  "hour_sin", "hour_cos",
  "dow_sin",  "dow_cos",
  
  "is_summer"
)

X <- as.matrix(fire[, feature_vars])
Y <- Surv(time = fire$time_to_hit_hours, event = fire$event)

set.seed(42)

cv_fit <- cv.glmnet(
  x            = X,
  y            = Y,
  family       = "cox",
  alpha        = 0.5, 
  nfolds       = 5,
  standardize  = TRUE,
  type.measure = "C"         # Harrell's C-index as CV criterion
)

# Plot CV curve
plot(cv_fit)
title("5-fold CV Elastic Net (alpha=0.5) — Cox Model", line = 2.5)

cat("\nOptimal lambda (lambda.min):", cv_fit$lambda.min, "\n")
cat("lambda.1se (more parsimonious):", cv_fit$lambda.1se, "\n")


# Use lambda.min for best predictive performance.
coef_min <- coef(cv_fit, s = "lambda.min")
selected_min <- rownames(coef_min)[which(coef_min != 0)]

cat("\nVariables selected at lambda.min (", length(selected_min), "):\n")
print(coef_min[selected_min, , drop = FALSE])
```


```{r}
################################################################
# PH Assumption Check (Schoenfeld Residuals)
################################################################
cox_formula <- as.formula(
  paste("surv_obj ~", paste(selected_min, collapse = " + "))
)

cox_fit <- coxph(cox_formula, data = fire)
summary(cox_fit)

# Score Test
ph_test <- cox.zph(cox_fit)
print(ph_test)

# Plot Schoenfeld residuals for each variable
par(mfrow = c(ceiling(length(selected_min) / 3), 3))
plot(ph_test)
par(mfrow = c(1, 1))
```



```{r}
#######################################################
# Model Fitting - Baseline Survival Function
#######################################################
fire_scaled <- fire %>%
  mutate(across(c(log1p_area_first, log_radial_growth, 
                  log_centroid_speed, alignment_cos,
                  hour_cos, dow_sin, dow_cos), scale))
vars_formula <- surv_obj ~ log1p_area_first + log_radial_growth +
                            log_centroid_speed + alignment_cos + 
                            hour_cos + low_temporal_resolution_0_5h + 
                            dow_sin + dow_cos + is_summer
aft_weibull     <- flexsurvreg(vars_formula, data = fire_scaled, dist = "weibull")
aft_exp         <- flexsurvreg(vars_formula, data = fire_scaled, dist = "exp")
aft_gengamma   <- flexsurvreg(vars_formula, data = fire_scaled, dist = "gengamma")
aft_lognormal  <- flexsurvreg(vars_formula, data = fire_scaled, dist = "lognormal")
aft_loglogistic <- flexsurvreg(vars_formula, data = fire_scaled, dist = "llogis")
aft_gamma       <- flexsurvreg(vars_formula, data = fire_scaled, dist = "gamma")

aic_comparison <- data.frame(
  Distribution = c("Weibull", "Exponential", "Generalized Gamma", "Log-normal", "Log-logistic", "Gamma"),
  AIC = c(AIC(aft_weibull), AIC(aft_exp), AIC(aft_gengamma), AIC(aft_lognormal), 
          AIC(aft_loglogistic), AIC(aft_gamma)),
  BIC = c(BIC(aft_weibull), BIC(aft_exp),
          BIC(aft_gengamma), BIC(aft_lognormal), 
          BIC(aft_loglogistic), BIC(aft_gamma))
) %>% arrange(AIC)

print(aic_comparison)
```

```{r}
library(caret)
############################################
# Initial AFT Model (fit using survreg())
############################################
fit_llogis_initial <- survreg(
  surv_obj  ~ 
    log1p_area_first + log_radial_growth +
    log_centroid_speed + alignment_cos + 
    hour_cos + low_temporal_resolution_0_5h + 
    dow_sin + dow_cos + is_summer,
  data = fire_scaled,
  dist = "loglogistic"
)

# Multicolinearity
car::vif(fit_llogis_initial)

###############################################################
# Perform Model Selection (AIC, BIC, In-sample C-index, 3-fold CV C-index)
###############################################################

# Only radial growth
fit_llogis_radial <- survreg(
  surv_obj  ~ 
    log1p_area_first + log_radial_growth +
    alignment_cos + hour_cos + low_temporal_resolution_0_5h + 
    dow_sin + dow_cos + is_summer,
  data = fire_scaled,
  dist = "loglogistic"
)
# Only centorid
fit_llogis_centroid <- survreg(
  surv_obj  ~ 
    log1p_area_first + log_centroid_speed + alignment_cos + 
    hour_cos + low_temporal_resolution_0_5h + 
    dow_sin + dow_cos + is_summer,
  data = fire_scaled,
  dist = "loglogistic"
) 

# AIC & BIC

aic_colinear <- data.frame(
  Model = c("Full 9-Variable", "Radial Growth Only", "Centroid Speed Only"),
  AIC   = c(AIC(fit_llogis_initial), AIC(fit_llogis_radial), AIC(fit_llogis_centroid)),
  BIC   = c(BIC(fit_llogis_initial), BIC(fit_llogis_radial), BIC(fit_llogis_centroid))
) %>% arrange(AIC)

print(aic_colinear)

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# In-sample C-index
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
form_initial <- Surv(time_to_hit_hours, event) ~ 
  log1p_area_first + log_radial_growth + log_centroid_speed +
  alignment_cos + hour_cos + low_temporal_resolution_0_5h + 
  dow_sin + dow_cos + is_summer

form_centroid <- Surv(time_to_hit_hours, event) ~ 
  log1p_area_first + log_centroid_speed +
  alignment_cos + hour_cos + low_temporal_resolution_0_5h + 
  dow_sin + dow_cos + is_summer

form_radial <- Surv(time_to_hit_hours, event) ~ 
  log1p_area_first + log_radial_growth +
  alignment_cos + hour_cos + low_temporal_resolution_0_5h + 
  dow_sin + dow_cos + is_summer

model_formulas <- list(
  initial  = form_initial,
  centroid = form_centroid,
  radial   = form_radial
)

insample_results <- data.frame(
  Model = character(),
  C_index = numeric(),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

for (model_name in names(model_formulas)) {
  
  fit_full <- survreg(
    formula = model_formulas[[model_name]],
    data = fire_scaled,
    dist = "loglogistic"
  )
  
  lp_full <- predict(fit_full, newdata = fire_scaled, type = "lp")
  
  c_index <- concordance(
    Surv(time_to_hit_hours, event) ~ lp_full,
    data = fire_scaled
  )$concordance
  
  insample_results <- rbind(
    insample_results,
    data.frame(
      Model = model_name,
      C_index = round(c_index, 4)
    )
  )
}

cat("\n=== In-sample C-index ===\n")
print(insample_results)

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 3-Fold CV C-index
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
set.seed(260)
folds <- createFolds(fire_scaled$event, k = 3, list = TRUE)

cv_results <- data.frame(
  Model = character(),
  Fold_1 = numeric(),
  Fold_2 = numeric(),
  Fold_3 = numeric(),
  Mean_CV_C_index = numeric(),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

for (model_name in names(model_formulas)) {
  
  current_formula <- model_formulas[[model_name]]
  cv_c_index_list <- numeric(3)
  
  for (i in 1:3) {
    test_idx <- folds[[i]]
    train_data <- fire_scaled[-test_idx, ]
    test_data  <- fire_scaled[test_idx, ]
    
    fit_cv <- survreg(
      formula = current_formula,
      data = train_data,
      dist = "loglogistic"
    )
    
    lp_test <- predict(fit_cv, newdata = test_data, type = "lp")
    
    cv_c_index_list[i] <- concordance(
      Surv(time_to_hit_hours, event) ~ lp_test,
      data = test_data
    )$concordance
  }
  
  cv_results <- rbind(
    cv_results,
    data.frame(
      Model = model_name,
      Fold_1 = round(cv_c_index_list[1], 4),
      Fold_2 = round(cv_c_index_list[2], 4),
      Fold_3 = round(cv_c_index_list[3], 4),
      Mean_CV_C_index = round(mean(cv_c_index_list), 4)
    )
  )
}

cat("\n=== 3-Fold CV C-index ===\n")
print(cv_results)
```


```{r}
###################################
# FINAL AFT Model (8 predictors)
###################################
aft_loglogistic <- flexsurvreg(
  surv_obj  ~ 
    log1p_area_first + log_centroid_speed + alignment_cos + 
    hour_cos + low_temporal_resolution_0_5h + 
    dow_sin + dow_cos + is_summer,
  data = fire_scaled,
  dist = "llogis"
)

fit_llogis <- survreg(
  surv_obj  ~ 
    log1p_area_first + log_centroid_speed + alignment_cos + 
    hour_cos + low_temporal_resolution_0_5h + 
    dow_sin + dow_cos + is_summer,
  data = fire_scaled,
  dist = "loglogistic"
)

est_table <- aft_loglogistic$res
aft_table <- data.frame(
  Covariate = c(
    "Shape ($\\kappa$)",
    "Scale",
    "Log Initial Area",
    "Log Centroid Speed",
    "Alignment Cosine",
    "Hour (cos)",
    "Low Temporal Resolution (Yes)",
    "Day of Week (sin)",
    "Day of Week (cos)",
    "Summer (Yes)"
  ),
  est       = round(est_table[, "est"], 3),
  SE        = round(est_table[, "se"], 3),
  L95       = round(est_table[, "L95%"], 3),
  U95       = round(est_table[, "U95%"],   5)
) %>%
  mutate(
    `95% CI` = ifelse(
      Covariate %in% c("Shape ($\\kappa$)", "Scale"),
      NA,
      paste0("(", format(round(est_table[, "L95%"], 3)),
             ", ", format(round(est_table[, "U95%"], 3)), ")")
    )
  ) %>%
  select(Covariate, est, SE, `95% CI`) 

kable(aft_table,
      caption = "AFT Model Estimates (Log-logistic Distribution)",
      row.names = FALSE,
      col.names = c("Coavriate", "Estimate", "SE", "95% CI"), 
      align   = c("l", "c", "c", "c"))

```




```{r}
################################
# Model Diagnosis
################################
lp <- predict(fit_llogis, type = "lp")

sigma <- fit_llogis$scale

S_hat <- 1 - psurvreg(
  q = fire$time_to_hit_hours,
  mean = lp,
  scale = sigma,
  distribution = "loglogistic"
)

eps <- 1e-12
S_hat <- pmax(S_hat, eps)

# Cox-Snell residual
cs_resid <- -log(S_hat)

# Martingale residual
mart_resid <- fire$event - cs_resid

# Deviance residual
dev_resid <- ifelse(
  fire$event == 1,
  sign(mart_resid) * sqrt(
    pmax(0, -2 * (mart_resid + log(pmax(fire$event - mart_resid, eps))))
  ),
  sign(mart_resid) * sqrt(pmax(0, -2 * mart_resid))
)

# DFBETA
dfb <- residuals(fit_llogis, type = "dfbeta")

diag_llogis <- fire
diag_llogis$lp          <- lp
diag_llogis$S_hat       <- S_hat
diag_llogis$cs_resid    <- cs_resid
diag_llogis$mart_resid  <- mart_resid
diag_llogis$dev_resid   <- dev_resid

km_cs <- survfit(Surv(cs_resid, fire$event) ~ 1)

plot(
  km_cs$time,
  -log(km_cs$surv),
  type = "s",
  xlab = "Cox-Snell Residual",
  ylab = "Estimated Cumulative Hazard",
  main = "Cox-Snell Residual Plot (survreg log-logistic)"
)
abline(0, 1, col = "red", lwd = 2, lty = 2)

covariates <- c(
  "log1p_area_first",
  "log_centroid_speed",
  "alignment_cos", 
  "hour_cos",
  "dow_sin", "dow_cos"
)

par(mfrow = c(3, 3), mar = c(4, 4, 2, 1))

for (v in covariates) {
  x <- diag_llogis[[v]]
  y <- diag_llogis$mart_resid
  
  plot(
    x, y,
    xlab = v,
    ylab = "Martingale-like Residual",
    pch = 16, cex = 0.6
  )
  
  if (length(unique(x[!is.na(x)])) > 1) {
    lines(lowess(x, y), col = "red", lwd = 2)
  }
  
  abline(h = 0, lty = 2, col = "blue")
}

par(mfrow = c(3, 3), mar = c(4, 4, 2, 1))
for (v in covariates) {
  x <- diag_llogis[[v]]
  y <- diag_llogis$dev_resid
  
  plot(
    x, y,
    xlab = v,
    ylab = "Deviance-like Residual",
    pch = 16, cex = 0.6
  )
  
  if (length(unique(x[!is.na(x)])) > 1) {
    lines(lowess(x, y), col = "red", lwd = 2)
  }
  abline(h = 0, lty = 2, col = "blue")
}

ggplot(diag_llogis, aes(x = lp, y = mart_resid)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_smooth(method = "loess", se = FALSE) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = 2, color = "red") +
  labs(
    x = "Linear predictor",
    y = "Martingale-like Residual",
    title = "Martingale-like Residual vs linear predictor"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

ggplot(diag_llogis, aes(x = lp, y = dev_resid)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_smooth(method = "loess", se = FALSE) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = 2, color = "red") +
  labs(
    x = "Linear predictor",
    y = "Deviance residual",
    title = "Deviance residual vs linear predictor"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()


colnames(dfb) <- c(names(coef(fit_llogis)), "Log(scale)")
p <- ncol(dfb)
par(mfrow = c(3, 3), mar = c(4, 4, 2, 1))

for (j in 2:(ncol(dfb)-1)) {
  plot(
    dfb[, j],
    ylab = "DFBETA",
    xlab = "Observation Index",
    main = colnames(dfb)[j],
    pch = 16, cex = 0.6
  )
  abline(h = 0, lty = 2, col = "red")
}
```

```{r}
################################
# Probability Prediction
################################
p12 <- summary(aft_loglogistic, newdata = fire_scaled, t = 7, type = "survival")
p24 <- summary(aft_loglogistic, newdata = fire_scaled, t = 19, type = "survival")
p48 <- summary(aft_loglogistic, newdata = fire_scaled, t = 43, type = "survival")
p72 <- summary(aft_loglogistic, newdata = fire_scaled, t = 66.9944741327, type = "survival")

extract_prob_ci <- function(pred_list, horizon_label){
  out <- do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_along(pred_list), function(i){
    data.frame(
      row_id = i,
      horizon = horizon_label,
      time = pred_list[[i]][1, "time"],
      surv_est = pred_list[[i]][1, "est"],
      surv_lcl = pred_list[[i]][1, "lcl"],
      surv_ucl = pred_list[[i]][1, "ucl"],
      prob_est = 1 - pred_list[[i]][1, "est"],
      prob_lcl = 1 - pred_list[[i]][1, "ucl"],
      prob_ucl = 1 - pred_list[[i]][1, "lcl"]
    )
  }))
  rownames(out) <- NULL
  out
}

tab12 <- extract_prob_ci(p12, "12h")
tab24 <- extract_prob_ci(p24, "24h")
tab48 <- extract_prob_ci(p48, "48h")
tab72 <- extract_prob_ci(p72, "72h")

pred_long <- bind_rows(tab12, tab24, tab48, tab72) %>%
  select(-c("time", "surv_est", "surv_lcl", "surv_ucl")) %>%
  rename(
    ID = row_id,
    Horizon = horizon,
    `Est. Risk` = prob_est
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    `95% CI` = paste0(
      "(", sprintf("%.3f", prob_lcl), ", ", sprintf("%.3f", prob_ucl), ")"
    ),
    `Est. Risk` = sprintf("%.3f", `Est. Risk`)
  ) %>%
  select(ID, Horizon, `Est. Risk`, `95% CI`)

fire_info <- fire %>%
  mutate(ID = row_number()) %>%
  select(ID, event, time_to_hit_hours)

pred_top4 <- pred_long %>%
  group_by(Horizon) %>%
  slice_head(n = 4) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(Horizon = factor(Horizon, levels = c("12h", "24h", "48h", "72h"))) %>%
  arrange(ID, Horizon) %>%
  left_join(fire_info, by = "ID") %>%
  mutate(event = ifelse(event == 1, "Yes", "No")) %>% 
  select(ID, event, time_to_hit_hours, Horizon, `Est. Risk`, `95% CI`) %>%
  rename(
    `Fire Hit` = event,
    `Time to Hit (h)` = time_to_hit_hours
  )

kable(pred_top4, align = "c", caption = "Predicted Fire Hit Probability by Horizon", digits = 3)
```


```{r}
######################################################################
# Model Evaluation (AUC & Brier Score)
######################################################################
library(timeROC)
library(pec)

eval_times <- c(7, 19, 43, 66.9944741327)

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Time-Dependent AUC 
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

lp_aft <- predict(fit_llogis, type = "lp")

roc_dynamic <- timeROC(
  T = fire$time_to_hit_hours,
  delta = fire$event,
  marker = -lp_aft,     
  cause = 1,
  weighting = "marginal",
  times = eval_times,
  iid = FALSE
)

cat("\n=== Time-Dependent AUC (AFT Model) ===\n")
auc_table <- data.frame(
  Horizon_Hours = c("12h", "24h", "48h", "72h"),
  Follow_up_Time = eval_times,
  AUC = round(roc_dynamic$AUC, 4)
)
print(auc_table)


# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Time-Dependent Brier Score
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

sigma <- fit_llogis$scale

eval_times_pec <- c(0, eval_times)

surv_prob_matrix <- sapply(eval_times_pec, function(t) {
  if (t == 0) {
    rep(1, nrow(fire)) 
  } else {
    1 - plogis((log(t) - lp_aft) / sigma)
  }
})

brier_dynamic <- pec(
  object = list("AFT_LogLogistic" = surv_prob_matrix),
  formula = Surv(time_to_hit_hours, event) ~ 1,
  data = fire_scaled,
  times = eval_times,
  exact = FALSE,
  cens.model = "marginal"
)

cat("\n=== Time-Dependent Brier Score (AFT Model) ===\n")
print(brier_dynamic$AppErr)

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# In-sample C-index
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

sample_c_index <- concordance(Surv(time_to_hit_hours, event) ~ lp_aft, data = fire_scaled)
cat("\n=== In-sample C-index (AFT Model) ===\n")

print(round(sample_c_index$concordance, 4))

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 3-Fold CV C-index
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
set.seed(260) 
folds <- createFolds(fire_scaled$event, k = 3, list = TRUE)

cv_c_index_list <- c()

for(i in 1:3) {
  test_idx <- folds[[i]]
  train_data <- fire_scaled[-test_idx, ]
  test_data <- fire_scaled[test_idx, ]

  fit_cv <- survreg(
    formula = Surv(time_to_hit_hours, event) ~ log1p_area_first + 
              log_centroid_speed + alignment_cos + hour_cos + 
              low_temporal_resolution_0_5h + dow_sin + dow_cos + is_summer, 
    data = train_data, 
    dist = "loglogistic"
  )
  
  lp_test <- predict(fit_cv, newdata = test_data, type = "lp")
  
  fold_c_index <- concordance(Surv(test_data$time_to_hit_hours, test_data$event) ~ lp_test)$concordance
  cv_c_index_list <- c(cv_c_index_list, fold_c_index)
}

cat("\n=== 3-Fold CV C-index (AFT Model) ===\n")
cat("Fold C-indices:", round(cv_c_index_list, 4), "\n")
cat("Mean CV C-index:", round(mean(cv_c_index_list), 4), "\n")

```


```{r}
######################################################
# Alternative directional-variable - adding alignment_abs
######################################################
fit_add_abs <- survreg(
  surv_obj  ~ 
    log1p_area_first + log_centroid_speed + alignment_cos + alignment_abs +
    hour_cos + low_temporal_resolution_0_5h + 
    dow_sin + dow_cos + is_summer,
  data = fire_scaled,
  dist = "loglogistic"
)

fit_only_abs <- survreg(
  surv_obj  ~ 
    log1p_area_first + log_centroid_speed + alignment_abs +
    hour_cos + low_temporal_resolution_0_5h + 
    dow_sin + dow_cos + is_summer,
  data = fire_scaled,
  dist = "loglogistic"
)

cat("\n=== Information Criteria (AFT Model) ===\n")
cat("AIC:", AIC(fit_llogis), AIC(fit_add_abs), AIC(fit_only_abs), "\n")
cat("BIC:", BIC(fit_llogis), BIC(fit_add_abs), BIC(fit_only_abs), "\n")


aic_abs <- data.frame(
  Model = c("only cos", "Both (cos + sin)", "only abs"), 
  AIC   = c(AIC(fit_llogis), AIC(fit_add_abs), AIC(fit_only_abs)),
  BIC   = c(BIC(fit_llogis), BIC(fit_add_abs), BIC(fit_only_abs))
) %>% arrange(AIC)

print(aic_abs)

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# In-sample C-index
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
form_both <- Surv(time_to_hit_hours, event) ~ 
  log1p_area_first + log_centroid_speed + alignment_cos + alignment_abs +
    hour_cos + low_temporal_resolution_0_5h + 
    dow_sin + dow_cos + is_summer

form_abs <- Surv(time_to_hit_hours, event) ~ 
    log1p_area_first + log_centroid_speed + alignment_abs +
    hour_cos + low_temporal_resolution_0_5h + 
    dow_sin + dow_cos + is_summer

model_formulas <- list(
  abs_only = form_abs,
  both   = form_both
)

insample_results <- data.frame(
  Model = character(),
  C_index = numeric(),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

for (model_name in names(model_formulas)) {
  
  fit_full <- survreg(
    formula = model_formulas[[model_name]],
    data = fire_scaled,
    dist = "loglogistic"
  )
  
  lp_full <- predict(fit_full, newdata = fire_scaled, type = "lp")
  
  c_index <- concordance(
    Surv(time_to_hit_hours, event) ~ lp_full,
    data = fire_scaled
  )$concordance
  
  insample_results <- rbind(
    insample_results,
    data.frame(
      Model = model_name,
      C_index = round(c_index, 4)
    )
  )
}

cat("\n=== In-sample C-index ===\n")
print(insample_results)

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 3-Fold CV C-index
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
set.seed(260)
folds <- createFolds(fire_scaled$event, k = 3, list = TRUE)

cv_results <- data.frame(
  Model = character(),
  Fold_1 = numeric(),
  Fold_2 = numeric(),
  Fold_3 = numeric(),
  Mean_CV_C_index = numeric(),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

for (model_name in names(model_formulas)) {
  
  current_formula <- model_formulas[[model_name]]
  cv_c_index_list <- numeric(3)
  
  for (i in 1:3) {
    test_idx <- folds[[i]]
    train_data <- fire_scaled[-test_idx, ]
    test_data  <- fire_scaled[test_idx, ]
    
    fit_cv <- survreg(
      formula = current_formula,
      data = train_data,
      dist = "loglogistic"
    )
    
    lp_test <- predict(fit_cv, newdata = test_data, type = "lp")
    
    cv_c_index_list[i] <- concordance(
      Surv(time_to_hit_hours, event) ~ lp_test,
      data = test_data
    )$concordance
  }
  
  cv_results <- rbind(
    cv_results,
    data.frame(
      Model = model_name,
      Fold_1 = round(cv_c_index_list[1], 4),
      Fold_2 = round(cv_c_index_list[2], 4),
      Fold_3 = round(cv_c_index_list[3], 4),
      Mean_CV_C_index = round(mean(cv_c_index_list), 4)
    )
  )
}

cat("\n=== 3-Fold CV C-index ===\n")
print(cv_results)
```
